paragraphs: 2 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Friday for 2 clubs across 2 levels, with Zach Daudet producing the night's most notable performance.
Zach Daudet produced a double in the second to center field on a 1-1 pitch from Jacob Bimbi.
Zach Daudet went 1-for-3, 1 double, 1 run scored, 1 walk.
He batted seventh and started at shortstop.
Brooks Lee went 0-for-4 for Minnesota Twins. He batted second and started at third base. Minnesota Twins fell to Chicago White Sox, 1-4.
title: Zach Daudet highlights a busy Friday for former Mustangs
